lines.en: label halloweenfive5:
scene amimayaween1
: Wow. Have I really been away for so long that you’re trying to rent out my side of the room?
lines.zh: : 哇。我是不是真的离开了太久，你都打算把我这一半房间租出去了？

lines.en: : Not actively. I just didn’t recognize any of the names on your dry erase board and they were starting to make me feel uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 也不是主动要租。只是你白板上的名字我一个都不认识，它们开始让我觉得不舒服了。

lines.en: : Wait, were you not the one writing those?
lines.zh: : 等等，那些不是你写的吗？

lines.en: scene amimayaween2
: No. And I feel like someone is clearly messing with us because I could have sworn it was you writing on my board this whole time. But those names kept popping up even when you were gone.
lines.zh: : 不是。而且我觉得明显有人在耍我们，因为我一直以为这整段时间都是你在我的板上写字。可那些名字在你不在的时候也不断冒出来。

lines.en: : It’s probably Makoto. She’s secretly evil. We should go get back at her by flipping the number on her door upside down.
lines.zh: : 大概是 Makoto。她骨子里是坏的。我们应该去报复她，把她门牌上的数字倒过来。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, why are we here in the first place? I thought we were going to the party?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我们一开始为什么在这儿？我们不是要去派对吗？

lines.en: scene amimayaween3
: We are! I just need to get something first.
lines.zh: : 是要去啊！我只是得先拿个东西。

lines.en: Ami and Maya were the best of friends! And now that Maya was obedient again, Ami had no reason to harbor any ill will against her!
lines.zh: Ami 和 Maya 是最好的朋友！而既然 Maya 又听话了，Ami 就没有理由再对她怀有任何恶意了！

lines.en: Which isn’t to say she ever did in the first place. I mean, just look at her! How could a girl that cute ever harbor any ill will against anyone?
lines.zh: 这并不是说她以前怀过。我是说，看看她！那么可爱的女孩怎么可能对任何人怀有恶意呢？

lines.en: scene amimayaween4
She was so good! And all of those scary things she says and/or is involved with were all just speculation based on the testimony of someone equally as untrustworthy! But again, that was fine now!
lines.zh: 她是那么的好！而所有那些她说过、或者牵涉其中的可怕事情，都只不过是基于某个同样不可信的人的证词所做的猜测！不过再说一次，现在那些都无所谓了！

lines.en: The girls were back in business!
lines.zh: 女孩们重新开工了！

lines.en: : Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : The girls are back in business!
lines.zh: : 女孩们重新开工了！

lines.en: : ...What?
scene amimayaween5
: Nothing! Just excited to finally be together again.
lines.zh: : 没什么！只是很高兴终于又在一起了。

lines.en: Maya Makinami was perturbed! She’d been away from her ailing friend for so long now that she forgot she sometimes talked to herself.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 感到不安！她离开这位抱恙的朋友太久了，久到她都忘了对方有时会自言自语。

lines.en: scene amimayaween6
And she also had no idea how to look at her anymore now that she knew she had been secretly masturbating to the sounds of her fucking her uncle.
lines.zh: 而且她也不知道该怎么再看她了——现在她知道，对方一直在听着她和她叔叔做爱的声音偷偷自慰。

lines.en: : You know, I feel like the air between us has been a little weird ever since we decided we were going to take back what is rightfully ours.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，自从我们决定要夺回理应属于我们的东西之后，我觉得我们之间的气氛就一直有点怪。

lines.en: : I feel like that’s an extreme understatement.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话说得太轻描淡写了。

lines.en: : Do you want to kiss each other now just so we can try and get used to it before the big moment?
lines.zh: : 你想现在先亲一下吗，好让我们在关键时刻之前先适应适应？

lines.en: scene amimayaween7
: What?! No!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不要！

lines.en: : Not even a little bit?
lines.zh: : 一点点也不行？

lines.en: scene amimayaween8
: Didn’t you say you needed to get something?
lines.zh: : 你不是说你要拿什么东西吗？

lines.en: : Oh, Maya. You’re so cute when you pretend that your love for Sensei is all pure and innocent! This is going to be the greatest threesome ever!
lines.zh: : 哦，Maya。你装作自己对 Sensei 的爱纯洁无瑕的样子真的好可爱！这会是有史以来最棒的三人行！

lines.en: scene amimayaween9
: Now where did I put my key?
lines.zh: : 那么我把钥匙放哪儿了？

lines.en: : Key?

lines.en: : Yeah. The one I got from a box of EnviroKidz Gorilla Munch cereal back in junior high. It’s supposed to open anything. And Ayane has a bunch of rooms we can fuck my dad in that no one else can get to.

lines.en: : That did absolutely nothing to dispel any of my confusion.
lines.zh: : 这完全没有消除我任何一点困惑。

lines.en: scene amimayaween10

lines.en: scene amimayaween11
: Ami, just because I agreed to do this with you doesn’t mean I can just...go back to normal right away. I don’t think you’re really grasping how much this Niki thing is getting to me.
lines.zh: : Ami，我答应和你一起做这件事，不代表我能立刻……恢复正常。我觉得你没真正理解 Niki 这件事对我的打击有多大。

lines.en: : I’m not grasping it? Just imagine how I feel. She’s stealing two roles at once from me. Besides, you’re not even supposed to know Niki. Should I start asking questions about that next?
lines.zh: : 我不理解？你想想我的感受。她一次抢走了我的两个角色。再说了，你本来就不该认识 Niki。接下来要不要我也问问那个？

lines.en: : What if he doesn’t want to talk to me?
lines.zh: : 万一他不想跟我说话呢？

lines.en: : God, you’re so self-centered. Would it kill you to pity me for a second? I clearly have it worse than you.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你也太以自我为中心了。可怜我一下会死吗？我明显比你惨。

lines.en: : Ami, what specifically determines if a boy breaks up with you?
lines.zh: : Ami，具体来说，是什么决定了一个男生会不会和你分手？

lines.en: : Usually when he chooses someone else and asks them to move in with him without telling you.
lines.zh: : 通常是他选了别人、还不告诉你就叫对方搬进来的时候。

lines.en: scene amimayaween12
: But then-
lines.zh: : 可是那样——

lines.en: scene amimayaween13
scene amimayaween14
: But?
lines.zh: : 可是？

lines.en: : Yes.
: I’m confused.

lines.en: : Yeah...me too.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也是。

lines.en: scene amimayaween15
Want to hear a secret truth about something that makes this Maya worse than the last one?
lines.zh: 想听一个秘密真相吗——关于这个 Maya 比上一个更糟的地方？

lines.en: This one had never done anything sexual with her roommate! That other Maya, though? Yeesh. She was no stranger to that at all.
lines.zh: 这一个从来没有和她的室友做过任何性相关的事！可那个 Maya 呢？哎呀。她对此可一点都不陌生。

lines.en: In fact, she’d all but perfected the art of dick-sandwich tribadism by now after spending thousands of years sharing her “beloved” with his precious niece in an act of desperate confusion, anger, and super intense lust!

lines.zh: 我是说，那种欲望强到爆表。因为直到大概一百万年之后，她才弄明白怎么重置自己的数值。

lines.en: But anyway, yeah. This Maya hadn’t done that yet. And she was going to have to learn tribadism all over again. But hey, she has always said that Ami is the cutest girl in the world, so at least there’s that!
lines.zh: 不过算了，总之。这个 Maya 还没做过那个。她得把磨镜从头学一遍。不过嘿，她一直都说 Ami 是世界上最可爱的女孩，所以至少还有这点安慰！

lines.en: scene amimayaween16
: Hey, didn’t you used to have a bunch of boxes in here?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你以前这儿是不是有一堆箱子？

lines.zh: : 对。就是那种我每次想打开你都会超级生气的。那些去哪儿了？

lines.zh: : 我……不太确定你在说什么。大概是我们搬进来的时候我拆包收拾好了。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. And when did we move in again?
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那我们是什么时候搬进来的来着？

lines.en: : This...year?
: You’re sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : I mean...we’re freshmen. So...yeah?
lines.zh: : 我意思是……我们是新生。所以……对吧？

lines.en: scene amimayaween17

: Yeah, I guess that was a dumb question. I’ve just been cooped up for so long that time’s started to turn into a weird blob. Like, I can’t even remember what you dressed up as for Halloween last year.

lines.en: : Wasn’t I Homura last year? Or was that two years ago?

lines.zh: : 哦，对……你说得对。而我扮的是 Madoka。

lines.en: : That feels so long ago now, doesn’t it?

lines.en: : I...guess? Also, do you need help? Because you’ve been down there for a while and-
lines.zh: : 我……想是吧？还有，你需要帮忙吗？因为你在下面待了好一会儿了——

lines.en: scene amimayaween19
: Bingo. Side quest: complete. Sorry it took so long. I’ve been keeping it under a loose floorboard.
lines.zh: : 找到了。支线任务：完成。抱歉花了这么久。我一直把它藏在一块松动的地板下面。

lines.en: : Why?

lines.zh: : 因为那是限量版钥匙啊，Maya！这玩意儿只做了寥寥几把。

lines.en: : And I’ve got it hard enough with you fucking Sensei’s brains out all over town. The last thing I need is you having access to even more locations in which you can cuck me.

lines.en: : I’m not sure I ever will. Especially with you suddenly being so open about my relationship with him when I would have put money on you stabbing me with that key just a week ago if you found out.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我永远做得到。尤其是你现在突然对我和他的关系这么开放——要是一个星期前你发现了，我敢拿钱打赌你会拿那把钥匙捅我。

lines.en: : Drastic times call for drastic measures! We’re competing with a giant now. And the only way we have a shot is by combining vaginas.

lines.en: scene amimayaween22
: I really love you, Ami. Thank you for...not hating me even though I’ve...done probably the worst thing I could have done to you.
lines.zh: : 我真的很爱你，Ami。谢谢你……没有恨我，尽管我……大概做了我能对你做的最糟的事。

lines.zh: : 我只是……从来没想过要伤害你。Sensei 那么久以来一直是我的整个世界，所以——

lines.en: : Mhm. No need to get into detail. We’ve got work to do.
